9_canonical_theta_encode_decode_and_prov.note: to_canonical_theta(theta, was_swapped) applies T_theta (negate theta[2]) iff swapped; from_canonical_theta undoes it. ThetaProvenance separates theta0 (Bellman/centre) from theta_exec (selected). ThetaBox: z=2(theta-lo)/span-1, denorm clips to legal box -> Tanh actor can never emit out-of-box.

10_r1_baseline_recorded.r1_khead_model: KHeadProposalNet(k=4, feat_dim=43, h=128): trunk Linear(43,128)+ReLU+Linear(128,128)+ReLU, heads Linear(128, 4*6=24), output Tanh -> ThetaBox.denorm (canonical theta centres).
10_r1_baseline_recorded.batching: full-batch: each dev state contributes one variable-size set-loss term per epoch; mean over states; one Adam step per epoch.
10_r1_baseline_recorded.loss: set_loss = permutation-invariant bidirectional Chamfer (recall: each acceptable target -> nearest head; precision: each head -> nearest target) + head-collapse hinge (diversity_weight=0.5, margin=0.8) GATED on is_multimodal_target_set (spread>0.8).
10_r1_baseline_recorded.normalisation: features: R1 fixed per-group physical scales (R1_NORM_SCALES); labels: ThetaBox.norm (canonical theta in [-1,1]).
10_r1_baseline_recorded.output_bounds: Tanh -> ThetaBox.denorm -> always legal 6-D theta in the frozen delivery box.
